title: Normalized pullback of coefficient-tower Tate lines
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$ and a morphism $f:X\to Y$. Use the recorded normalized tower geometry [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels] and the finite Tate-line realizations of [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal]. Pull a pro-etale chart $U\to Y$ back to $X$; the root restriction is the map on roots induced by the actual global-sections ring homomorphism. Evaluate the ordinary adjunction transpose of a tower module map using the recorded direct-image evaluation comparison. Define line-pullback data as an isomorphism from the ordinary inverse image of the scalar-extended root line on $Y$ to that on $X$, whose evaluated adjoint on every pure tensor $a\otimes z$ is precisely $f^*(a)\otimes f^*(z)$ under the fixed finite Tate-line realizations. No free root map, scalar map, adjunction or finite comparison is chosen.
